Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by unilaterally standardizing the comparison to US release dates and even asserted an unsupported US availability year (2015) for Dis-moi qui tuer. The question simply asks which film came out earlier, which should be answered by comparing original release years (1965 vs. 2010). This misframing risks inverting the correct chronological order and led to unnecessary, repetitive searches instead of using the clear original release dates.
